questions.stem: Find the 10th term of the A.P. 3, 5, 7, 9, …
The mth term of an A.P. is n and the nth term is m. Show that the (m + n)th term is zero.
The 35th term of an A.P. is 69. Find the sum of its first 69 terms.
Which term of the G.P. 5, −10, 20, −40, … is 320?
Three numbers are in G.P. Their sum is 43 and their product is 216. Find the numbers in proper order.
Find the sum to n terms of the sequence 8, 88, 888, …
Find the sum of the infinite G.P. 1 + 1/3 + 1/9 + 1/27 + … ∞

questions.stem: The A.M. and the G.M. of two positive numbers are 10 and 8 respectively. Find the numbers.
The sum of two numbers a and b is 6 times their geometric mean. Show that the numbers are in the ratio (3 + 2√2) : (3 − 2√2).
If the A.M. and the G.M. between two numbers are in the ratio m : n, prove that the numbers are in the ratio m + √(m² − n²) : m − √(m² − n²).
The common difference of an A.P. is 3 and the 15th term is 37. Find the second term.
If the mth term of an A.P. is 1/n and the nth term is 1/m, show that the (mn)th term is 1.
Find the sum of 2 + 3 + 5 + 6 + 8 + 9 + … to 2n terms.
Insert five arithmetic means between 8 and 26.
Find the 5th term of the G.P. 4, 8, 16, …
The third term of a geometric progression is 4. Find the product of the first five terms.
Find the sum to n terms of the sequence 0.7, 0.77, 0.777, …
Find the sum of the infinite terms of the G.P. 1/3, −2/9, 4/27, −8/81, …

questions.stem: Insert three geometric means between 1 and 81.
The arithmetic mean between two positive numbers is 34 and their geometric mean is 16. Find the numbers.
If one geometric mean g and two arithmetic means p and q are inserted between two numbers, show that g² = (2p − q)(2q − p).
Let x be the arithmetic mean and let y, z be the two geometric means between any two positive numbers. Show that y³ + z³ = 2xyz.
Find the sum to n terms of the series 1·2 + 2·3 + 3·4 + …
